name: Grape Manifest
summary: Milly Osworth records her rescued grape harvest for Northshire Abbey. She writes a manifest of the yield recovered from Defias thieves, then sends it to Brother Neals so the brotherhood can replenish its wine stores.

sections.title: The Valley's Vintage
sections.body: Northshire Valley's soil and orchards have long supported local food and the abbey's wine. When thieves and bandits seized the eastern fields, they cut off the abbey's supply of grapes and food. With the harvest recovered from the occupied fields, Milly Osworth records the yield in a manifest.

sections.title: A Tipple in the Belfry
sections.body: Brother Neals oversees food and drink at Northshire Abbey. He is known for sampling Northshire's vintages in the quiet of the bell tower. Brigands still threaten the gates, but fresh grapes give the brotherhood a moment to toast the Light and take heart.

faq.answer: Milly Osworth writes the Grape Manifest to record her harvest recovered from Defias thieves. The ledger lets the abbey's quartermaster restock its cellars.
Brother Neals is a monk at Northshire Abbey who oversees its food and drink. He often samples the vintages in the bell tower.

faq.q: Where do I find Brother Neals?
faq.answer: Brother Neals is inside Northshire Abbey, in the bell tower overlooking the grounds.

faq.q: Why is Northshire's grape crop so important?
faq.answer: Northshire's grapes provide celebrated wine and fresh food for the local clergy and soldiers. A lost harvest threatens daily stores and the abbey's sacramental wine across Elwynn.
Defias brigands occupied Northshire Valley's eastern fields, drove Milly Osworth out, and hid her boxed harvest throughout the vineyards. They were driven back by adventurers.

faq.q: What happens after giving Brother Neals the manifest?
faq.answer: Brother Neals gives his blessings in the name of the Light. He is overjoyed that the abbey's cellars will have fresh wine despite the bandit troubles across the valley.

angles.text: Securing Northshire's food stores helps Stormwind's main place of recruitment and recovery remain self-sufficient.
As a human beginning your journey, helping Milly and Brother Neals protects one of the kingdom's cherished pastoral traditions.
As a priest, you know wine has a place in both hospitality and sacramental rites at Northshire Abbey, where farming sustains the brotherhood's worship.
